source_text: Critics of Brit Shalom highlight that uncircumcised males face elevated risks of conditions like balanitis and phimosis, potentially requiring later interventions with higher complication rates, though long-term population studies in low-circumcision regions like Europe show no epidemic of such issues attributable to intact status.
